DIAGNOSIS READY: Subacute combined degeneration of the spinal cord due to Vitamin B12 deficiency (likely Pernicious Anemia).

The patient's combination of progressive gait ataxia, motor weakness, and cognitive decline (dementia/paranoia) over weeks to months is highly suggestive of B12 deficiency. I will now request blood work to confirm this diagnosis.
